Subject: Quick demo at Cloud Native Summit — Thursday morning?

Hi Vanessa / Sarah,

We’ll be at Cloud Native Summit next week in Barcelona. I wanted to see if we could lock a short 30–40 minute product demo while we’re on-site. I have a gap on Thursday morning around 10:00 — that’s the time shown on my hotel clock.

If you can do 10:00 that day I’ll grab a quiet meeting room and my colleague Sarah will join remotely (she’s traveling from Singapore and is flexible). I assume you mean 10:00 local time (Barcelona), but my phone is still on PDT from the road — apologies in advance if I mixed zones.

Hi Tom — welcome to Barcelona!

Quick clarifying question: do you mean 10:00 CET (local Barcelona time) or 10:00 PDT (your phone)? To avoid the classic hotel-watch vs calendar mismatch I want to be explicit.

We have two straightforward options that week:
- Option A: Thu 2025-11-04 10:00 CET (11/4 10:00 Europe/Barcelona) — 30–40 min on-site-friendly demo.
- Option B: Thu 2025-11-04 11:00 CET — slightly later, gives us an extra 20 minutes for a live workload run (preferred if you expect heavy-latency questions).

If you confirm which local time you meant, I’ll send the invite and loop in my product engineer. I’ve also attached the summit floorplan in case you need directions to our booth.

Cheers,

Folks — forwarding the thread. Tom asked to move to 11:00 CET (local) on Thu 2025-11-04. Can we confirm we have a clean demo environment at that time? A couple of notes:

- Marcus: the demo run includes a live rerank stage against a 10k prompt set. That’s fine on Dedicated but we need to ensure the GPU pool is warmed (KV cache primed). Can you schedule a warm-up job 30 mins prior?
- Priyom: can you standby for a quick rollout rollback plan if the longer sequence test triggers a perf regression? If we keep it to 35–40 minutes we should be okay, but want the contingency.

Also attaching the CN-Summit-floorplan.png in case you want to meet at the booth beforehand. I’ll update the calendar invite to 11:00 CET / include the conference room details.

Thanks — I’ll confirm with Tom after you reply.

—Vanessa
